messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning to enable model aurora-7b-v3 in the catalog tonight at 11:00 UTC. Change window 11:00-12:30 UTC. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 100% (30m steps).

maya: Need to update the fallback ordering for runtime routing: prefer quant-v2, then baseline-13b, then safe-fallback-6b. Also we should pin eu region to aurora-7b-v3@2026-03-21-01 to avoid drift during the cutover. Any objections?

deploybot: Scheduled job created: `/deploy catalog enable aurora-7b-v3 --canary 5,20,100 --window 2026-03-21T11:00Z/2026-03-21T12:30Z --pin eu:aurora-7b-v3@2026-03-21-01`

ben: +1 on timing. Suggest we add a safety cutoff: auto rollback if error_rate > 1% OR p95 latency > 750ms for 3m.

carla: Agree. Also recommend pre-cutover warmup to prime KV and prefix caches — run at 10:30 UTC. Example warmup command: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.local/warmup -d '{"model":"aurora-7b-v3","prompts":["Hello","Summarize this"]}'
```

ryan: For the fallback map, ensure quant-v2 is available in eu-west-1. If quant-v2 capacity is missing, route to baseline-13b-ff (fast-fallback) before hitting safe-fallback-6b. Add region-aware checks to the routing policy.

jamie: I'll create the observability salvo. Dashboard: `catalog/aurora-cutover`. Alert rule: `IF error_rate > 1% for 3m OR p95_latency > 750ms for 3m -> trigger rollback`. I'll post the alert IDs here once created.

ops-bot: Created incident channel #inc-aurora-cutover and pinned runbook https://redwood/runbooks/aurora-cutover. Ops on-call: @jamie.

liz: For release notes I'll add a blurb: "Enable aurora-7b-v3 (pinned) with improved latency profile; fallback order updated to prefer quant-v2." Will include model hash and pin info.

maya: Nice. @deploybot please queue warmup at 10:30 UTC and then execute canary sequence at 11:00 UTC. Post canary status (success/fail) in this thread.

deploybot: Acknowledged. Warmup job queued for 2026-03-21T10:30:00Z. Canary job scheduled to start at 2026-03-21T11:00:00Z. Will emit status updates.

ben: If rollback is triggered, prefer automated rollback to previous stable model (catalog-stable@LATEST) and notify PG + product. Also increment rollback counter in release notes.

carla: Confirming quant-v2 capacity in eu-west-1 now (checked infra). Will reserve ephemeral slots for the first 20% canary.

ryan: One more ask: add a shallow-delay between regions to avoid simultaneous pressure — eu then na then apac staggered by 10m.

maya: Good call. Staggering eu->na->apac with 10m offsets. Locking in 11:00 UTC start. @jamie you'll be primary for alerts?

jamie: I'll be standby at 10:45-12:00 UTC and monitoring the dashboard. If I see the rollback conditions hit I'll execute the rollback play and post summary.

ops-bot: Runbook action added: `pre-cutover: warmup (10:30) -> reserve capacity -> start canary (11:00) -> monitor (11:00-12:30)`

liz: I'll draft a short customer-facing note and a longer internal blurb with pin/version and fallback map.

maya: Awesome, thanks everyone. :thumbsup: Locking plan. @deploybot please post a reminder 45m before warmup.

deploybot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-21T09:45:00Z. Will post again 30m and 5m before warmup.

maya: If anything changes, call it here. Otherwise we roll at 11:00 UTC.

ben: +1. Good luck.

carla: I'll be online for the window.

jamie: Oncall acknowledged.

liz: Will update release notes after the cutover.
